div.div: Sixty frames a second is 16.7 ms per frame. A layout pass over a large tree does not fit in it; a composite does.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 758px; height: 1px; padding-top: 474px; margin-left: 38px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-info-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-info-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: The preload scanner races ahead while the parser is blocked and starts downloading anything it can see — but it only reads markup. A font named inside a stylesheet, or a chunk imported by JavaScript, is invisible to it.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 527px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif; color: var(--dg-warn-fg); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: CSS blocks the paint and a synchronous script blocks the parse — and a script that reads layout ends up blocked on the CSS too. Animate transform and opacity because they skip the two expensive stages entirely.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
